messages.subject: [Cipsr-users] Welcome message
messages.body_plain:
Welcome to the cipsr mailing list!  This list is used to update the users and developers of cipsr with important news and program developments.  You should be able to manage the frequency of updates from this mailing list.  If you are receiving to many messages, please contact the administrator.  The objective of this mailing list is not to overwhelm your inbox with messages about cipsr!

I strongly encourage you to use this mailing list to advance the development of cipsr and associated work.

Read more about making posts to the mailing list at:
http://lists.r-forge.r-project.org/cgi-bin/mailman/listinfo/cipsr-users

Nate Osborne

messages.subject: [Cipsr-users] Second cipsr workshop held tomorrow
messages.body_plain:
On October 21, we will hold the second cipsr workshop at the Bureau of Land Management District Office in Salem (1717 Fabry Rd SE).  Our first workshop was held at Oregon State University earlier this year for CIPS members.  Interested parties should meet at the parking lot outside Peavy A002B at 7:45 AM.  The workshop should begin around 9:00 AM.  We are expecting the workshop to conclude around noon.  A van will return to Corvallis, for anyone needing to be back to campus by 1:00 PM. If you cannot attend the meeting, but wish to review the workshop materials, send an e-mail to Nathaniel.Osborne at oregonstate.edu.  Additional workshops can be held and custom tailored to your organizational needs.

Cheers,
Nate Osborne
